title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - FabricWearable
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/FabricWearable. A fabric wearable integrates its sensors directly into its fibers (e.g. a woven ECG shirt). Subclass of TextileBasedWearable per the SAREF4WEAR ontology. The source ontology declares no additional own data/object property for this subclass beyond the classification itself: all properties are documented on the TextileBasedWearable, OnBodyWearable and WearableDevice models and not repeated here (notably hasSensor, on WearableDevice, for the fibre-integrated sensors).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'FabricWearable'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
